messages:
ashok: apac-east dedicated pool showing intermittent tail latency spikes on short inference workloads since ~02:10 UTC. CPU/GPU util steady but p99 token latency climbed from ~120ms to ~600ms.
maya: noticed that too. any tenant correlation? :eyes:
julia: our canary flipped at the same time. tracing points to a single tenant (t-42) with massive egress bursts.
kevin: host-level logs indicate NIC tx-queue backlog and softirq saturation. looks like packet-spray causing long softirq durations -> NIC interrupts starving userland.
ashok: snippet from host syslog:
```
netdev: tx-queue 4 backlog 13540 pkts
kernel: softirq-CPU=2 dur=420ms
eth0: tx_dropped=194
```
maya: that pattern matches previous packet-spray incidents when model-parallel batchers flood the network with many small outbound packets.
julia: immediate options: throttle t-42 or migrate their allocs out of the apac-east slice. which is fastest?
kevin: fastest is egress policer; migration causes backfill churn. I'll enqueue a policer at 12 Mbps for t-42 and monitor.
ops-bot: action: applied egress policer pol-781 to tenant t-42. monitoring p99 for 15m.
maya: p99 dropped to ~160ms within 3 mins after policer. good sign.
ashok: for resilience we should add scheduler-side routing weight driven by NIC health: if host.softirq_ratio > 0.2 and tx_queue > 8k, reduce routing weight for heavy-egress tenants for that AZ for 30m.
julia: also add a host flag 'egress-shield' when sustained tx_queue>10k for 5m; scheduler should avoid placing new heavy-egress allocs on shielded hosts.
kevin: note: moving noisy tenants increases churn and may harm packing. need cost estimate vs SLA risk.
maya: back-of-envelope: single noisy tenant off a 16-GPU dedicated slice costs ~0.6 GPU-hours/day in backfill inefficiency, still cheaper than repeated SLO breaches.
ashok: proposed playbook:
1) auto-apply policer + soft-evict to sibling AZ (fast mitigation).
2) scheduler weight from host-egress-health to influence routing for 30m (policy change).
julia: agree. telemetry: emit metric host.egress_softirq_ratio and host.tx_queue_len. add alert if ratio>0.2 && tx_queue>8000 for >2m.
kevin: I'll open PRs: (a) policer automation, (b) telemetry + alert, (c) scheduler weight. tagging @maya @julia for review.
maya: SGTM. after canary we'll run synthetic egress burst tests to validate warm-pool behavior.
ashok: follow-up: if policer fails to contain blasts in 15m, we escalate to tenant migration and incident.
ops-bot: incident created INC-2028 (apac-east-tail-latency). responders: ashok,maya,kevin,julia.
